author: Lightrunner
quote: I have a couple issues with the game. the story is good which is the most important thing, but this game is a perfect example of two things. why bigger isn't always better and why doing too much realism is a problem. First of the bigger thing. The map is simply way too big when you need to get somewhere. like when Jason gets his first hunting mission it's so far away it takes forever to get there and somehow you lose signal on the way and can't see where to go anymore etc it was very problematic. then in vice city it took forever to reach the side of the city where I could grab my vintage car from the ultimate edition and get back to the main quest, they could benefit a lot with condensing the size a lot more. making it this much bigger makes it take longer to get places and makes it a bigger chance you crash into things on the way. on that note we get to the realism stuff. the way some cars are near impossible to drive. muscle cars feel like you're driving on ice, the moment you start pressing the drive button and need to turn your car begins to do donuts, and the first time you get one of these cars is in a mission you need to escape cops so cops will get free shots while you're trying to figure out how the hell this car even works. then there's gas... why the f did they add gas in the cars? there's literally no reason but annoy players to force you to refuel a car. It's GTA not real life. i should be able to take my car and run anytime, not have to worry about running out of gas for some reason. then we have the equipment... i'm fine with only able to have two long guns and two side arms. what is a problem is you need to stash the long guns in your car or people panic. it's extremely annoying because when you actually NEED the guns you're in a mission where your car isn't around and now you don't have the guns you desperately need. Cops impounding your cars when you die is also really annoying, especially because it's hard to get in and out without being noticed, and then you have to waste time trying to outrun them again. and then you get the whole thing abut a big ass search area, even worse if a main quest is in the middle of it. then comes mission lock bs... there's moments in the game where you're stuck with "explore" It's extremely annoying for someone who doesn't WANT to explore and do side content and just want to do main story content, because it wastes valuable time I could have used to enjoy story. So it has a lot of flaws, some can be manageable, but it would have been better to have less realism, smaller size and more robust game

author: Lightrunner
quote: The remake shows how well it holds up even compared to modern games despite originally releasing back in the 90's. the jump and voiced cutscenes added a while bigger layer to it all. they did an amazing job in keeping the scary parts of the well and the shadow temple. even managed to make redead more scary than before. I've definitely not been disappointed in any way
